boundary_notice: The greatest risk for agricultural engineers is not AI but a small job market. AI improves calculations, but the total number of roles is limited. Choosing the right employer and specialization matters more than working hard without direction.

fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits people who can work in fields, produce drawings, and communicate with farmers. The technical work requires electromechanical and water-resources knowledge, while sites demand patience and close construction observation.

personality_fit_block.callout: For people who can work in fields, draw plans, and communicate with farmers, agricultural engineering is a practical career whose reputation grows with experience.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Resilience: fieldwork is routine

On-site ability: closely manage construction and commissioning

personality_fit_block.callout: If you can accept late-night deliveries, messy hands-on work, and the deep satisfaction of watching a litter grow, this career is likely a good fit.

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI, but academic labor oversupply. After ten years of doctoral training, you can still fail to secure a stable teaching role, a calculation every humanities doctoral student must make early.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit people who use a PhD to avoid employment or expect an easy permanent position. Humanities doctorates bring publication pressure, up-or-out systems, and years of low-paid temporary academic work. Those unable to tolerate uncertainty should be cautious.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: bachelor's degree → master's in philosophy/religious studies → doctorate abroad or domestically → postdoc/lecturer on an up-or-out contract → publish papers and secure projects → promotion to associate professor and professor. Some also teach at leading secondary schools or humanities institutions.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits people who genuinely love thinking and watching others think. If you can revise a student's argumentative structure three times and enjoy being challenged by students in class, treating critical thought as pleasure, you can sustain this career.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you love thinking so much that you feel compelled to teach others, and accept a demanding, lengthy academic path, philosophy teaching offers both freedom and pressure.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Critical-thinking ability: enjoys argument and refutation
Expression: makes abstract ideas concrete
Patience: maintains expectations for students who develop slowly
Self-discipline: continues producing without attendance controls
Resilience: withstands long-term publication and assessment pressure

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「学术劳动力过剩」——读博十年，最后可能拿不到一个稳定教职，这是每个文科博士都要提前算清的账。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合把读博当逃避就业、想轻松拿编制的人。文科博士的苦你躲不掉：发表压力、非升即走、低薪多年的学术临时工阶段，扛不住不确定性的人慎入。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：本科 → 哲学/宗教学硕士 → 博士（海外或国内）→ 博士后/讲师（非升即走）→ 发论文、拿项目 → 评副教授、教授；也有部分人进入重点高中或人文机构任教。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合「真的爱想问题、也爱看别人想问题」的人。你能为一篇学生论文的论证结构改三遍，也享受在课堂上被学生反驳——把思辨当乐趣，这行才走得下去。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你爱思考爱到「不教别人就难受」，并接受它是一条清苦而漫长的学术路，哲学教职会给你自由，也会给你压力。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 思辨力：享受论证与反驳
表达力：能把抽象讲得具体
耐心：对学生的慢热保持期待
自律：没有考勤也要持续产出
抗压：发表与考核的长期压力

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not wholesale replacement by AI, but tools absorbing basic tasks. People who only press buttons will be replaced first.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This work does not suit people who dislike dirty or strenuous conditions, cannot stay focused, or have no interest in mechatronics. Robotics technicians often work on the floor, climb to elevated areas, and compete with production teams for maintenance windows. People who are easily discouraged will find it difficult.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: an associate or bachelor's degree in mechatronics or automation → commissioning assistant at an integrator or factory → electrician or industrial robot operation and maintenance certification → independent on-site engineer.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits people who enjoy hands-on tasks, understand circuits, can read diagrams, and know how to tune parameters. If making equipment run steadily gives you a sense of achievement, this can be a stable career.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you enjoy analyzing how things work and use reliable equipment operation as your standard, robotics technician is one of manufacturing's most future-oriented technical entry points.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Hands-on: confident with assembly and disassembly
Circuit knowledge: read diagrams and trace signals
Patience: stay focused while tuning parameters
Alertness: respond effectively to emergencies
Organization: document work clearly

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 整体替代，而是「低阶动作被工具吃」——只点按钮的人最先被替。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合怕脏累、坐不住、对机电没兴趣的人。机器人现场常要趴地、爬高、跟产线抢停机窗口，玻璃心会很难受。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：机电/自动化大专或本科 → 进集成商或工厂做调试助理 → 考电工/工业机器人操作运维证 → 独当一面做现场工程师。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合爱动手、懂电路、能读图又会调参数的人。你愿意把「让设备稳稳跑起来」当成就，这行就稳。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你爱琢磨机理、把「让设备稳稳跑」当标准，机器人技术员是制造业最贴近未来的技术入口。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 爱动手：拆装不怵
懂电路：读图查信号
耐性：调参坐得住
机敏：突发能救
条理：记录写清楚

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI itself, but whether your work consists only of tasks AI can perform. People who only make calls and recite scripts will be replaced, while those who combine relationships, solutions, and negotiation will always have a market.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This work does not suit people who are sensitive, cannot tolerate rejection, or dislike numeric targets. Sales performance is measured by results, and emotionally fragile people rarely last three months.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: associate or bachelor's degree → telesales representative or sales assistant → serve smaller clients and gain experience → key account sales/account manager → specialize in an industry such as finance, IT, or logistics → sales supervisor or regional manager.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits people who are thick-skinned, quick-thinking, and enjoy interacting with others. If you can smile and make the next call after rejection and frame product shortcomings as solutions to client pain points, sales is your arena.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you enjoy the control that comes from persuading someone and accomplishing a goal, and you can withstand numeric targets and rejection, sales will convert your value into tangible income.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Resilience: performance targets are daily work
Communication: make complex solutions resonate
Insight: hear the client's true needs behind their words
Persistence: recover quickly after rejection
Self-motivation: visit clients without close supervision

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「你做的事是不是只有 AI 也能做」——只会打电话念话术的会被取代，能把关系、方案和谈判组合起来的，永远有市场。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合脸皮薄、受不了拒绝、讨厌数字指标的人。销售是按业绩说话的，玻璃心在这个行业活不过三个月。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：大专/本科毕业 → 从电话销售或销售助理做起 → 跑小客户攒经验 → 转大客户销售/客户经理 → 按行业赛道深耕（金融、IT、物流等）→ 晋升销售主管或区域经理。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合脸皮厚、脑子快、爱跟人打交道的人。你能在被拒之后笑嘻嘻地拨下一通电话，能把产品的缺点说成客户的痛点解决方案，这行就是你的主场。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你享受「说服一个人、搞定一件事」的掌控感，又扛得住数字和拒绝，销售会把你的价值兑现成实实在在的收入。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 抗压：业绩指标是每天的功课
沟通：把复杂方案讲到人心里
洞察：听得出客户话里的真需求
韧性：被拒之后的恢复速度
自驱：没人盯着也能跑客户

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI, but emotional depletion. Without supervision and support systems, even committed teachers leave. A professional support network is essential for longevity.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This work does not suit emotionally fragile or impatient people seeking rapid results. Special education has no shortcut, and both parental expectations and children's regressions require strong psychological resilience.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: special education or early childhood education major → relevant teaching credential including special education → supervised internship at a special education school or inclusive preschool → individual-training teacher → accumulate assessment and intervention experience → rehabilitation specialist, resource-room leader, or curriculum development.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits genuinely patient, emotionally stable people who do not demand immediate results. If a child's small improvement can make you happy all day, there is a place for you in this field.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you can accept days when progress is measured in months and results often go unseen, yet remain moved by one moment of eye contact or the word 'teacher,' this field probably suits you.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Patience: repeat one instruction dozens of times without frustration
Empathy: understand the child from within their world
Emotional stability: remain calm when the child has a meltdown
Observation: notice every small improvement
Learning ability: continuously update evidence-based interventions

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「被情绪耗干」——没有督导和支持系统，再热爱的老师也会被磨走；建立专业支持网络，才能干得久。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合玻璃心或急功近利的人。特教没有速成，家长的期待、孩子的反复，都需要极强的心理承受力。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：特殊教育或学前教育专业 → 考取相应教师资格证（含特教方向）→ 在特教学校或融合园实习受训 → 从个训教师做起，积累评估与干预经验，往康复师、资源教室负责人或教研方向发展。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合真有耐心、情绪稳、不追求「立竿见影」的人。你要是能为一个孩子的一点进步高兴一整天，这行有你的位置。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你能接受「进步以月计、成果常不被看见」的日子，还愿意为一次对视、一声「老师」感动很久，这行大概率适合你。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 耐心：一个指令重复几十遍不烦躁
同理心：能站在孩子的世界理解他
情绪稳定：孩子崩溃你先稳住
观察力：细小的进步都要看见
学习力：循证干预方法持续更新

boundary_notice: The risk lies in knowing only manual material cutting. Nesting software and CNC cutting are replacing this work. Develop assembly precision, drawing interpretation, and equipment operation, and the robotics era will need you even more.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit people who fear heights, dislike noise, or work carelessly. Cutting creates heavy noise and dust, and field work involves climbing. Misreading one dimension can ruin an entire beam.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: apprentice at a structural steel plant → learn drawing interpretation, layout, cutting, and assembly → earn welding or fitter skill credentials → master CNC cutting and BIM layout → advance to team leader, quality inspector, or process technician.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits dexterous people who read drawings and can remain on their feet. Steel components often weigh hundreds of kilograms, requiring overhead-crane operation, angle-grinder skill, and careful reading of every dimension. Attention to detail and physical stamina are equally essential.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you enjoy turning drawings into physical structures and are willing to make precision second nature in the workshop, this trade offers a technical career that becomes more valuable with experience.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Drawing interpretation: Read dimensions immediately and accurately
Dexterity: Cut, assemble, and level steadily and precisely
Stamina: Handle large-component lifting and prolonged standing
Attention to detail: Reject millimeter-level errors
Safety awareness: Follow rules for work at height and lifting

boundary_notice: 这行的风险在「只会手工下料」——套料软件和数控切割在替掉这部分活。往装配精度、读图和设备操作上走，机器人时代反而更缺你这样的人。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合恐高、怕吵、粗心的人。车间里切割噪音大、粉尘多，现场作业要爬高；尺寸看错一个数，整根梁可能就废了。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：进钢结构厂当学徒 → 学看图纸、放样、切割、装配 → 考取焊工或装配工技能等级 → 掌握数控下料与 BIM 放样 → 往班组长、质检、工艺技术员方向升级。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合手巧、能看图、站得住的人。钢构件动辄几百公斤，要会用行车吊装、会用角磨机打磨，还要能看懂图纸上的每一个尺寸标注，细心和体力缺一不可。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你喜欢「图纸变实物」的成就感，又愿意在车间里把精度练成肌肉记忆，这行会给你一条越老越值钱的技术路。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 看图能力：尺寸标注一眼到位
手巧：切割、装配、校平稳准
体力：大件吊装、久站扛得住
细心：毫米级误差不放过
安全意识：高空与吊装作业守规矩
